ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The snake keeps its things in locker 6. ... The frog keeps its things in locker 7. ... The elephant keeps its things in locker 5. ... The pig keeps its things in locker 3. ... In which locker does the animal known for oinking keep its things?" -> answer org 3; the alt prompt asks about the snake (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 6 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 5 (answer at the same slot counted from the start), 8 (answer at the same slot counted from the end), 7 (answer at the same token position), 1 (the alt prompt's own answer), 3 (answer org kept).
